run_solver_stage: run a stage method on the BaseSolver and automatically log its metrics and duration
log_metrics_solver: log metrics for a given stage using the BaseSolver log_metrics method
init_tensorboard_solver: initialize Tensorboard logging from a Dora experiment using BaseSolver init_tensorboard
restore_checkpoint_solver: restore a solver checkpoint from disk using the BaseSolver restore method
register_stateful_solver: register attributes to be saved and restored in checkpoints using register_stateful
